config.admission: All 4715 registered locations per thickness, all eight separate refinement comparisons, both source identities and potential overlap must pass unchanged targets. Independent all-point potential/gradient/Hessian finite differences retain their separate 0.0001 gate. This audit alone does not admit a production provider.
config.method: Use Z(k,z)=2 f_physical(z)/k+O(k^-3) only for the omitted interval k>K. Evaluate the resulting A_K through the 2D log Green identity and the retained finite-k transform. Radial derivatives belong to that same explicit potential, using its radial Poisson identity; analytic physical sech-squared derivatives supply vertical factors. Preserve the higher-order tail residual and check it against the original physical source. Small-R even series avoids singular numerical quotients.
config.precision_method: Evaluate the same stored PCHIP polynomial coefficients, central coefficient and physical cosine taper with cloned mpmath contexts. Refine Gauss-Legendre nodes and weights at the same registered order. Sum the low-k potential and radial-gradient integrals in high precision, cache source-independent Bessel values, and use compensated sums for the remaining high-k band. Update all radial derivatives consistently with the changed first derivative; retain the original source identities and independent finite differences.
config.registration: After the retained source-tail-002 grid pass, failed source-tail-verification-001 and successful exposed-point high-precision diagnostic. Before any full-grid precise-tail execution. Keep all physical source prescriptions, coordinates, 60--80 kpc join and numerical targets unchanged. Refine the cancellation arithmetic, low-k Bessel band and same-order source Gauss rule; retain additional precision and band comparisons.
config.scope: Numerical completion of the original fixed source potential. Not a changed physical source, new gravity formula, full nonlinear action solve, production interpolation or independent observational confirmation.

source_config.normalizers: Same force, Hessian, third-tensor and density/source-gradient scales as the preceding join audit, evaluated on the reference assembled field. Five one-factor refinements, density and density-gradient identities must pass at every point, including the old outer grid now covered by the exterior provider. The potential-zero difference on the overlap must meet 1e-6 in monopole units. Standalone near-field errors where that provider has zero weight are diagnostic only; no erroneous inactive field is inserted into the actual potential. All source variants and all coordinates are retained.
source_config.registration: After the failed 80--120 kpc join and the independent order-128 exterior admission from 60 kpc, before evaluating this denser grid. Evaluate one potential with a fixed 60--80 kpc transition at every registered point. Keep all numerical tolerances unchanged and retain every old grid coordinate. Failed prior runs are not reclassified.
source_config.scope: Finite grid audit of one matched Newtonian potential. This does not validate a production interpolant, the action flux and separate Poisson solve, any new physical gravity card, direct outer-star motion, or astronomical confirmation.
